item.title: Adani Group stocks surge over India-US trade deal, Adani Enterprises leads
item.description: Mumbai: Stocks of the Adani Group companies surged on Tuesday in early trade after the announcement of the India-US trade deal, led by Adani Enterprises Ltd (AEL), which traded near the upper circuit of 10 per cent.Adani Green and Adani Energy also gained more than 7 per cent as the stock market rallied. item.title: Air India Begins Fleet-Wide Checks After Fuel Switch Issue On Boeing 787 Flight
item.description: Air India has ordered precautionary inspections of fuel control switches across its Boeing 787 Dreamliner fleet after a malfunction was reported on a London–Bengaluru flight, officials said.

item.title: PM Modi Says Patience Paid Off On US Trade Deal, Signals Confidence To Critics
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi told NDA MPs that India’s trade agreement with the US reflects strategic patience, creating a favourable economic climate and validating the government’s approach to global trade negotiations.

item.title: Border 2 Continues Strong Run on Day 11 at the Box Office
item.description: Released on January 23, ‘Border 2’ had sky-high expectations from fans. This was because Border from 1997 has become a cult classic over the years.

item.title: ED raids multiple locations in Bengal's West Burdwan in sand-coal smuggling cases
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) officers conducted raids on Tuesday at multiple locations in West Bengal as part of its investigation into sand and coal smuggling cases.

item.title: ICC yet to decide on India vs Pakistan clash amid boycott concerns
item.description: There have been plenty of predictions as to what sanctions the ICC could bring down on the PCB due to the Pakistan government’s boycott of the india vs pakistan t20 world cup group game against India on February 15, but ESPNcricinfo has reported that the world governing body has taken no steps so far towards punishing Pakistan.
